events.title: Bay Street May Open Higher, But Tech Weakness May Weigh
events.description: The Canadian market may open higher on Thursday, tracking firm precious metals and oil prices. However, a sell-off in global tech stocks amid concerns over returns on AI-related investments could hurt sentiment and limit market's upside.

events.title: New York Manufacturing Index Surges Much More Than Expected In October
events.description: New York manufacturing activity rose sharply in the month of October, according to a report released by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York on Thursday.

events.title: Philly Fed Index Tumbles Much More Than Expected In October
events.description: A report released by the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia on Thursday showed a steep drop by its reading on regional manufacturing activity in the month of October.

events.title: Growth Surprise Lifts FTSE 100
events.description: The FTSE 100 benchmark of the London Stock Exchange rallied on Thursday amidst positive sentiment generated by the better-than-expected GDP reading.

events.title: U.S. Retail Sales Climb Much More Than Expected In September
events.description: The Commerce Department released a report on Thursday showing retail sales in the U.S. increased by much more than expected in in the month of September.

events.title: U.S. Producer Prices Jump Much More Than Expected In September
events.description: Following yesterday's report on consumer price inflation, the Labor Department released a separate report on Thursday showing producer prices in the U.S. shot up by much more than expected in the month of September.

events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Inch Up To 199,000
events.description: A report released by the Labor Department on Thursday showed first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits edged slightly higher in the week ended October 10th.

events.title: CAC 40 Outperforms Broader Markets
events.description: The CAC 40 index that tracks the 40 largest French stocks based on the Euronext Paris rallied on Thursday. The outperformance came despite a weak sentiment in global markets attributed to the selloff in tech stocks, high interest rates and worries about inflation.

events.title: UK Economy Logs Better-Than-Expected Growth
events.description:
The UK economy expanded marginally in August defying expectations of a moderate contraction, as growth in industrial production offset the fall in construction.

events.title: Ericsson Q3 Profit Drops, Sales Rise; Simplifies Operating Structure; Stock Gains
events.description: Swedish telecom major LM Ericsson reported Thursday sharply lower profit in its third quarter, hurt mainly by the absence of prior year's significant divestment gain. Revenues, however, grew from last year, primarily with higher sales in Networks. Following the news, shares of Ericsson were gaining around 11 percent in Sweden, and around 12 percent in the pre-market activity on the Nasdaq.

events.title: Eurozone Industrial Output Drops For Third Month
events.description: The euro area industrial production declined for the third straight month in August, suggesting that harsh weather and rising energy prices weighed on industrial activity. Industrial output dropped 0.5 percent on a monthly basis in August, which was bigger than the 0.3 percent fall posted in July, data from Eurostat showed Thursday.

events.title: DAX Declines On Thursday As Tech Slide Deepens
events.description: The DAX benchmark that tracks the performance of the 40 largest companies listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange declined on Thursday amidst worries over artificial intelligence and fears of rising interest rates.

events.title: Indian Shares Rally Led By IT Stocks
events.description: Indian shares ended Thursday's session on a buoyant note as information technology stocks extended recent gains amid an ongoing tech sell-off in global markets on concerns about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence trade.
